systems.tiers: city administrations: said to be practically implemented in 73 cities; agreement signed 13 December 2025 to begin in Arba Minch, Jinka and Wolayita Sodo with the South Ethiopia Regional Land Administration Bureau and Arba Minch University

note: The document reports an agreement to prepare a digital addressing system in three city administrations; it describes the system's purpose (addresses linked to Fayda and postal delivery), not how the city offices are connected or whether they work in it online.
